candidate_relations.reason: The candidate identifies Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) and a specific chromosomal abnormality (5q deletion) which is present in the reference. However, it omits the specific subtype of MDS (refractory anaemia with excess blasts-1) and the presenting complication (leukaemic vasculitis), which are crucial components of the full reference diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: MDS with 5q deletion vs. MDS with refractory anaemia with excess blasts-1 presenting with leukaemic vasculitis
